scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client: esbuild src/client/main.tsx --bundle --minify --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --format=esm --target=chrome120 --jsx=automatic --outfile=dist/public/app.js && cp src/client/styles.css dist/public/app.css && cp public/index.html public/icon.svg dist/public/ && mkdir -p dist/public/fonts && cp public/fonts/*.woff2 dist/public/fonts/
